description: This file defines the interface and implementation details for the PluginServer component within the WPEFramework. It includes class declarations for managing plugin services, communication channels, server lifecycle, and related infrastructure such as factory pools, subsystem management, and remote instantiation. The code handles plugin loading, interface querying, security, and network communication, serving as a core part of the plugin hosting and management system.

classes.name: PluginHost::Server
classes.description: Main server class managing plugin services, communication channels, and server lifecycle within the WPEFramework. Handles plugin loading, security, notifications, and network communication.

classes.name: PluginHost::Server::ForwardMessage
classes.description: JSON container for forwarding messages with callsign and data fields.

classes.name: PluginHost::Server::WorkerPoolImplementation
classes.description: Custom worker pool implementation with a dispatcher for task scheduling.

classes.name: PluginHost::Server::FactoriesImplementation
classes.description: Factory pool for creating web request, response, file body, and JSONRPC message objects.

classes.name: PluginHost::Server::Activity
classes.description: Utility class for internal logging and activity tracking within the plugin host.

classes.name: PluginHost::Server::WebFlow
classes.description: Represents the flow of web requests and responses, including request/response serialization and security checks.

classes.name: PluginHost::Server::SocketFlow
classes.description: Handles flow of socket data, including serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: PluginHost::Server::TextFlow
classes.description: Manages flow of text data over communication channels.

classes.name: PluginHost::Server::Service
classes.description: Represents a plugin service, managing its lifecycle, interfaces, and communication.

classes.name: PluginHost::Server::ServiceMap
classes.description: Manages collection of plugin services, including instantiation, lookup, and destruction.

classes.name: PluginHost::Server::Channel
classes.description: Represents a communication channel, handling requests, responses, and WebSocket interactions.

classes.name: PluginHost::Server::Channel::Job
classes.description: Base class for jobs dispatched within a channel, such as processing requests or JSON elements.

classes.name: PluginHost::Server::Channel::Override
classes.description: Configuration override container for plugin services.

classes.name: PluginHost::Server::ChannelMap
classes.description: Manages active communication channels, including connection cleanup and security revocation.

methods.name: Server::Open
methods.description: Starts the server, opening network sockets and initializing resources.

methods.name: Server::Close
methods.description: Shuts down the server, closing sockets and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Server::Notification
methods.description: Sends a notification message to connected clients.

methods.name: Server::Persist
methods.description: Persists current plugin configuration and override data.

methods.name: Server::Load
methods.description: Loads plugin configuration and override data from persistent storage.

methods.name: Channel::Set
methods.description: Assigns an ID, server reference, and service to a communication channel.

methods.name: Channel::Send
methods.description: Sends responses or data over the channel.

methods.name: ChannelMap::Timed
methods.description: Performs periodic cleanup of inactive channels.
